en.html:
Asking was hardly necessary. Doushin Yusa's reputation, I had heard of it.
He belonged to a branch of the Ashikaga family. But he hadn't just sat there enjoying the family name. He had become one of its pillars, largely through his deeds on the battlefield. One spear, and what he had done with it.

Probably among the strongest in all Rokuhara.

Still. The opponent he was approaching was the Silver Star.

Raichou"...No. Doushin sir cannot match her, after all."
Raichou"I shall have to go myself!"
Chachamaru"You're not going anywhere. All this way we've come, and now you'll spoil the whole thing? Ghanta."
Raichou"...Chachamaru?!"
Raichou"Where have you been all this time? What have you been—"
Chachamaru"Arre, no long conversation. The show's nearly over."
Chachamaru"Let me finish the work I came for."
Raichou"—"
Raichou"Go on, then. Say it."
Chachamaru"Raichou. We've come to kill you."
Raichou"I see."
Raichou"...So it was you. Everything, you arranged it."
Chachamaru"HA-HA-HA! Finally the understanding has arrived! All along, you people were dancing in the palm of MY hand!"
Kageaki"Strange. Mostly I remember you running here and there whenever something unexpected happened..."
Chachamaru"TOH KYA KARUN?! It's not a ninety-minute movie, bhai! Everything cannot go smoothly just because Madam Mastermind has made a plan!"
Kageaki"Disappointing performance."
Chachamaru"...Will work harder, sir."
Raichou"Hmph. Just the two of you, and you intend to challenge me?"
Raichou"Such excessive recklessness. Rather sweet, actually."
Chachamaru"Going to take it easy on us, then?"
Raichou"Not at all. Quite the reverse."
Raichou"I shall grind you into dust! HIZAMARU!"

雷蝶「……駄目。 　やはり童心様では及ばない」
雷蝶「麿が行くしかないわ！」
茶々丸「行かせねえよ。 　ここまで来てぶち壊しにさせるか」
雷蝶「……茶々丸!?」
雷蝶「あんた、今までどこで何を――」
茶々丸「長話は止そうぜ。 　もう終演時間が迫ってんだ」
茶々丸「用件だけ片付けさせろ」
雷蝶「――――――」
雷蝶「言ってごらんなさい」
茶々丸「雷蝶。 　おめーを殺しに来た」
雷蝶「そう」
雷蝶「……あんただったわけね。 　全てを仕組んでいたのは」
茶々丸「ハッハッハッ、ようやくわかったようだね。 　キミタチはずっとワタシの掌の上で踊って いたのだよ！」
景明「その割りには予定外の事態に右往左往する 姿ばかりが俺の印象に残っているが……」
茶々丸「仕方ないやん！ 　一時間半で完結する映画とは違うんだから、 そうそう何もかも黒幕の思う通りスムーズに 進みやしませんよっ！」
景明「がっかりだな」
茶々丸「……もっとがんばります」
雷蝶「ふんっ。 　あんた達二人きりで、麿に挑もうというの」
雷蝶「行き過ぎた無謀は可愛いわね」
茶々丸「手加減でもしてくれるって？」
雷蝶「まさか。 　逆よ」
雷蝶「――粉微塵にしてあげる!! 　膝丸!!」
